cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Tell Me Why
cards.instruction: Get someone to reveal the motive behind a choice by offering small pieces of your own truth as bait.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've decided we can discuss why you hid my invitation. I'll permit one fact about me first: I've hidden one when I felt left out.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You'd have gone without me. Can we leave it there?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No. I nearly skipped your birthday because Leah was invited. You may tell me whether being alone was the problem.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It was you liking her more. That's what scared me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you're authorized to know I counted your photos with her. Now answer the narrower question: did you hide my invitation to make me choose you?

reason: Reread found mine followed photos and could wrongly refer to hidden photos. Name the invitation explicitly; retain every other candidate line.
